scenes.narration: Your network devices are constantly reporting what happens. Some messages are trivial, and some are urgent. Syslog severity sorts them out.

scenes.heading: The hospital triage
scenes.narration: A hospital triages patients from zero to seven. Zero is an emergency, the most serious of all. Three is an error, and four is a warning. Six is informational, and seven is debugging. Messages travel over U D P port five fourteen by default.

scenes.heading: Basic setup
scenes.narration: Send logs to a server like this. Choose the log server. Pick the severity to send. Add timestamps. And read the local log.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Zero is the most severe. The default trap level is six. It uses U D P five fourteen.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Severity zero is the worst, and seven is the chattiest. Default trap level is informational. It runs on U D P five fourteen. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva syslog lab.
